info.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 2 - Finishing Touches

descriptions.notStarted: Jacob mentioned he'd need more help. Perhaps I should pay him a visit?
descriptions.inProgress: I went to see Jacob again, and his Sakura Garden is just about done. He wants to do something special for the first guests, so I've agreed to provide #b20 White/Purple Gift Boxes#k, #b10 Lupin Dolls#k and #b10 Toy Baby Seals#k. Shouldn't be too tough, and he's mentioned something special if I finish...
descriptions.completed: I finished getting everything for Jacob and returned to him for my reward-#bBlossom Juice#k! It tastes great!
